title: 2379. Minimum Recolors to Get K Consecutive Black Blocks

examples.explanation: One way to achieve 7 consecutive black blocks is to recolor the 0th, 3rd, and 4th blocks so that blocks = "BBBBBBBWBW". It can be shown that there is no way to achieve 7 consecutive black blocks in less than 3 operations. Therefore, we return 3.
No changes need to be made, since 2 consecutive black blocks already exist. Therefore, we return 0.
